encoding.view: The keys of a database view map (database collab views[view_id]) this fixture is about, as a newer client left them. A real view map has more keys (name, layout, layout_settings, filters, sorts, field_orders, ...); neither operation touches them.
encoding.open_pages_in: "side_peek" | "center_peek" | "full_page" (WP13 §3.8). Absent or unknown reads as absent and is never rewritten by an unrelated write.
encoding.write: SetViewOpenPagesIn: the value written, the keys the write may touch and the view map after it. Unknown keys are kept.
encoding.duplicate: The keys of the copy after duplicating the view. Web copies its configuration keys and the unknown key; Rust re-applies the raw open_pages_in key (the typed view drops unknown keys).
